task: Cough reflex: airway vagal-afferent sensory triggering (RAR mechanical + bronchopulmonary C-fiber chemical -> NTS -> brainstem cough CPG) + two-phase motor sequence (glottis-closed compression -> sudden opening -> choke-limited expulsive flow), forced against a REAL non-strawman reduced-compression-phase adversary (voluntary throat-clearing), geometrically bracketing central-airway choke-point velocity, plus dose-response (capsaicin/citric acid) and perturbation adversaries (ACEI, TRPA1, airway anesthesia).
confidence_tier: literature-anchored, multi-source over-determined (24 PMID/DOI citations, every one live-verified via NCBI eutils esearch->esummary->efetch or PMC full-text this session; an initial 11-PMID recall batch was esummary-checked first and 8/11 were wrong papers, confirming zero-recalled-and-trusted numbers used unchecked)

core_falsifier.pre_registered_threshold: compression-phase gastric pressure in [100,300] mmHg; a real (non-strawman) reduced-compression-phase adversary (throat-clearing) must fail to reach true cough's peak flow by >=50% margin AND fail an independent decorrelated real clinical-outcome threshold (Bach 1996, 160 L/min) that true cough clears; near-sonic central-airway velocity claim computed (not assumed) against a pre-registered >=50%-of-sound-speed bar.

compression_phase_pressure.honest_reading: mean and mean+2SD both fall inside the task band but do not themselves reach its 300 mmHg ceiling

second_decorrelated_leg_mechanical.finding: open tracheostomy tube (glottis bypassed) vs closed/occluded (flow forced through glottis): pharyngeal-swallow physiology measurably different in absence of subglottic air pressure
second_decorrelated_leg_mechanical.scope_limit: measured outcome is swallow physiology, not cough peak flow -- analogy only, different modality+population than the flow leg

independent_cohort_replication.note: confirmatory-only (healthy-cohort mean trivially exceeds impairment threshold), not equal-strength to the same-subject contrast above

velocity_bracket_near_sonic_check.cross_check_method: independently recomputed via a second formula (331.3*sqrt(T/273.15)=353.03 m/s vs sqrt(gamma*R*T/M)=353.05 m/s, agree to 0.006%)
velocity_bracket_near_sonic_check.v_lower_bound_basis: measured voluntary-cough flow (3.775 L/s) / measured RESTING tracheal area
velocity_bracket_near_sonic_check.v_upper_basis: frictionless Bernoulli ceiling from measured pressure (PMID 12857722) -- illustrative, not physically achieved
velocity_bracket_near_sonic_check.honest_reading: the literal acoustic-speed-of-sound reading of 'near-sonic' is likely an overstatement of realized velocity (4-5% of c_sound at realistic geometry); the validated mechanism is reaching a local compliant-tube WAVE speed (Dawson-Elliott), a physically distinct and generally much smaller quantity than acoustic sound speed

capsaicin_methodology_pmid_12657501.method: doubling uM concentrations to C2(>=2 coughs)/C5(>=5 coughs)

dose_response.capsaicin_c5_absolute_uM_honest_gap: methodology/reproducibility/safety/hypersensitivity-direction confirmed live; absolute healthy-adult reference concentration NOT independently pinned this session

ace_inhibitor_pmid_1616218.mechanism: bradykinin + substance P + prostaglandin accumulation (ACE=kininase II normally degrades bradykinin/substance P)

airway_anesthesia_pmid_2376253.dyclonine_dissociation: oral anesthesia present but NO cough-response reduction -- specific not general anesthesia effect

symmetric_qc_honest_complications.young_1987_pmid_3664020: productive cough (real expectoration) observed WITHOUT glottic closure / with low airflow in obstructive airways disease -- bounds the falsifier to peak-flow MAGNITUDE, refutes a blanket universal-necessity claim
symmetric_qc_honest_complications.lavietes_1998_pmid_9543286: peak cough flow correlates POORLY with esophageal pressure in real human coughs -- pressure and flow reported as independent facts, not one fitted transfer function
symmetric_qc_honest_complications.canning_mazzone_pmid_15004208_16051625: focal topical capsaicin/bradykinin does NOT itself evoke cough in guinea-pig trachea (only centrally sensitizes at nTS); cough-evoking fibers are a distinct capsaicin-INSENSITIVE A-delta population -- refines the task's stated C-fiber-triggers-cough framing; inhaled aerosolized capsaicin still reliably evokes human cough regardless (not fully reconciled this session)
symmetric_qc_honest_complications.canning_2006_review_pmid_16428690: RAR/C-fiber mediation of cough is its own review's words 'suggestive but inconclusive'; a third unclassified afferent subtype is flagged as potentially important

gate_weighting_note: not all gates carry equal evidentiary weight: central_falsifier (throat-clear vs cough vs Bach threshold) and velocity_bracket (near-sonic computation) are the discriminating tests that could plausibly have failed; dose_response and perturbation_adversaries gates are largely data-fidelity checks confirming cited facts are correctly transcribed, disclosed as such rather than flattened into one undifferentiated pass count.

decorrelated_anchor.description: Multiple independent, non-tautological external anchors -- none is a re-statement of the model's own output.
decorrelated_anchor.anchor_1_clinical_outcome: Bach & Saporito 1996 (PMID 8989078): the 160 L/min threshold was derived from REAL decannulation success/failure in n=49 neuromuscular patients -- a wholly different population and outcome variable than the healthy-volunteer flow measurements it is applied to here.
decorrelated_anchor.anchor_2_mechanical_different_modality: Gross et al 2003 (PMID 12597287): direct subglottic-pressure measurement in tracheostomized patients (open vs closed tube) -- different instrument (pressure vs flow) and population than the central falsifier's flow comparison, converging on the same glottis-engagement mechanism.
decorrelated_anchor.anchor_3_independent_cohort: Golac et al 2026 (PMID 41699249): different lab, different instrument (analog peak-flow meter vs pneumotachograph), different (older) population, same qualitative conclusion.
decorrelated_anchor.anchor_4_theory_independent_of_measureme: Dawson & Elliott 1977 (PMID 914721/914722): pure fluid-mechanics choke-point theory, empirically tested independently of any cough-specific measurement, explaining WHY glottic closure is load-bearing for peak flow.
decorrelated_anchor.never_a_tautology_gate: the compression-phase pressure (Man 2003) and the expulsion-phase flow (Mootassim-Billah 2025) are two independently-measured, different-population, different-instrument facts -- neither was fit to the other, and Lavietes 1998's own finding (poor Poes-flow correlation in real coughs) is disclosed rather than papered over.

honest_gaps: Capsaicin C5 absolute healthy-adult reference concentration (uM) not independently pinned this session.
Yanagihara et al 1966 (PMID 5963004) bibliographically confirmed only -- numeric findings not extracted (pre-abstract era, scanned full text).
Central-airway velocity during actual dynamic cough narrowing is bracketed (4-54% of c_sound), not pinned to one measured value -- no cough-specific tracheal %-narrowing citation found this session.
Gross et al 2003's own measured outcome is swallow physiology, not cough flow -- used as a scope-limited mechanical analogy.
Young et al 1987 refutes a blanket 'glottic closure necessary for ALL productive cough' claim -- falsifier correctly scoped to peak-flow magnitude only.
Lavietes et al 1998: pressure and flow correlate poorly in real coughs -- reported as two independent facts, not one fitted function.
Canning/Mazzone guinea-pig data complicate the task's stated RAR/C-fiber dual-afferent framing -- disclosed, not resolved.
Canning 2006 ACCP review itself grades RAR/C-fiber cough-mediation evidence as 'suggestive but inconclusive' and flags a third afferent subtype.
Brennan et al 2022's thresholds are a review-level corroboration of Bach & Saporito 1996, not a second independent measurement -- not double-counted.
Brainstem CPG circuitry (NTS -> CPG -> motor-neuron timing) described qualitatively only, not quantitatively modeled.

proposed_cell.claim: Compression-phase (glottis-closed) gastric pressure (157.7/121.4 mmHg M/F, Man 2003) falls inside the measured/task 100-300 mmHg band; a real non-strawman reduced-compression-phase adversary (voluntary throat-clearing, same-subject/instrument as cough) fails true cough's peak flow by a wide margin (137%, p<0.001) and fails an independent decorrelated clinical-adequacy threshold (Bach 1996, 160 L/min) that true cough clears, confirmed by a second decorrelated mechanical leg (tracheostomy glottis-bypass) and an independent-cohort replication; the task's 'near-sonic' central-airway velocity framing is computed (not assumed) and found to be an overstatement of realized velocity at realistic geometry (~4% of sound speed), though the underlying compliant-tube wave-speed choke-point mechanism (Dawson-Elliott 1977) is real and load-bearing for why glottic closure maximizes peak flow.
